detectedBy: Independent per-image Core localHashes parity assertion
cause: Pillow preserves embedded ICC profiles without applying the same sRGB normalization as the product sharp decoder; generated PNG files retained ICC metadata. Python hash input pixels therefore differed from actual Core input pixels.
fix: Normalize each source once with the existing product decoder before creating controlled crops. Keep crop seeds, rectangles, thresholds, feature settings and acceptance gates unchanged. Regenerate the entire partition; exclude no images.
